Airlie Oak.  This tree is said to be 400 years old.  I think it's more like 175, perhaps 200.  Was listed as being 128' tall in the NC State Big Tree list.

Charleston Parks lists this tree as covering 17,000 sq. ft.  I figured about 19,000 sq. ft.  It is often stated as being 1,000 years old with some estimates as high as 1,400 years.  In actuality, it is likely between 275 and 300 years old.

One limb is 106 ft. long.
This is the famous Middleton Oak.  It was once the second largest tree by volume in the Eastern United States before losing two very large limbs and numerous midsized limbs.
